question: Will the next 5 trading days be more volatile than usual for this stock?
model: 10 LSTMs trained on the platform's market with different seeds, every symbol pooled, days to 2026-05-31, early-stopped on days to 2026-06-30, scores averaged; scored on later days only; each month's call line is refit on the closed days before it, pooled over symbols, and the scores are shifted so it reads 0.5
rule: The next 5 days will be like the last 5
